# Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges) #for ridgeplot options
library(extrafont) #for plot font control
library(reshape2) #for site by species matrix
library(vegan) #for dissimilarity matrix
library(ggh4x) #for nested facets in plots
library(car)
font_import()
```

# Species Richness and Composition
## Richness
```{r}
#import
masterdata <- read.csv("masterdata2026_csv.csv")

#summary
masterdatasummary <- masterdata %>%
  group_by(Category.symbol) %>%
  summarize(n=n_distinct(Species))

#summary
masterdatasummarycat <- masterdata %>%
  group_by(Category.symbol) %>%
  summarize(n=n_distinct(Transect))

ggplot(masterdatasummary) + 
  theme_test() +
  geom_col(aes(x=Category.symbol, y=n), fill="#223204", alpha = 0.5, color="black") +  
   theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0)), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        text = element_text(family = "Open Sans Semibold", size = 25)) +
  scale_x_discrete() +
  xlab("Years Since Prescribed Burn") + 
  ylab("Richness")
```

##Ordinations, Composition 
```{r}
#import 
masterdata <- read.csv("masterdata2026_csv.csv")

#clean
names(masterdata)[names(masterdata) == "Transect.."] <- "Transect" #cleaning up column name for ease of later code

#pivot to make a row for each transect and a column for each species frequency in that transect (min = 0 / absent, max = all quadrats in transect)
#site_sp_matrix <- masterdata %>%
#  mutate(TransectUnique = paste(Burn.Unit, Transect), Presence = "1") %>%
#  dcast(TransectUnique ~ Species, value.var = "Presence", fun.aggregate = length, fill = 0)

site_sp_matrix <- masterdata %>%
  mutate(Transect = as.character(Transect), Presence = "1") %>%
  dcast(Transect ~ Species, value.var = "Presence", fun.aggregate = length, fill = 0)


#cleanup to allow vegdist() to work
rownames(site_sp_matrix) <- site_sp_matrix$Transect
  
#calculate pairwise dissimilarities, Bray-Curtis
bray_matrix <- vegdist(site_sp_matrix[,2:ncol(site_sp_matrix)], method = "bray")

#calculate NMDS scores for all pairwise dissimilarities
nmds <- metaMDS(bray_matrix, trymax = 999)
ordiplot(nmds)

#export NMDS scores for ggplot  
nmds_scores <- scores(nmds, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Transect")

#attach site and burn history information to NMDS scores list
sites <- masterdata %>%
  mutate(Transect = as.character(Transect)) %>%
  select(Category.symbol, Transect) %>%
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE)
nmds_scores <- nmds_scores %>%
  left_join(sites, by = "Transect")

#visuals
nmds_scores$Category.symbol <- as.factor(nmds_scores$Category.symbol)
ggplot(data = nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Category.symbol)) + 
  geom_point(size = 5) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 2), ylim = c(-1.5,1.5)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0)), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        text = element_text(family = "Open Sans Semibold", size = 25))


```

```{r}
#import 
focaldata <- read.csv("masterdata2026_csv.csv")

#clean
names(focaldata)[names(focaldata) == "Transect.."] <- "Transect" #cleaning up column name for ease of later code

focalsummary <- focaldata %>%
  mutate(Transect = as.character(Transect), Presence = "1") %>%
  dcast(Transect ~ Genus, value.var = "Presence", fun.aggregate = length, fill = 0)

focalsummary2 <- focalsummary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols= 2:last_col(), names_to ="Genus", values_to = "Present") %>%
  filter(Genus == "Vaccinium" | Genus == "Gaylussacia" | Genus == "Gaultheria" | Genus == "Rubus") 
 

focaldatastring <- focaldata %>%
  mutate(Transect = as.character(Transect)) %>% 
  mutate(Transect.unique = paste(Transect, Genus)) %>%
  select(Category.symbol, Transect.unique) %>%
  unique()

#attach burn history information to NMDS scores list
focalwithburn <- focalsummary2 %>%
  mutate(Transect = as.character(Transect)) %>%
  mutate(Transect.unique = paste(Transect, Genus)) %>%
  left_join(focaldatastring, by = "Transect.unique") %>%
  mutate(prop_present = Present/10)

focalpropsummary <-focalwithburn %>%
  group_by(Category.symbol) %>%
  summarise(avg = mean(prop_present))










```
